integrity: Finite chain checks are reproducible; general proof rests on exact link decomposition and the integral pair boundary. No independent scientific certification is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only Hamming scale two and a single puncture; the novelty is the integral coordinate-permutation split map, not the known nonequivariant wedge. One relevant full representation preprint was inaccessible; equivalence priority remains uncertain.
title: An integral coordinate-equivariant splitting at a puncture of the scale-two hypercube Rips complex
